note: Fixtures are built from a small Node/Express repo (rutas-api): POST /rutas committed, uncommitted work in src/geocode.js (sequential Nominatim + cache) and src/app.js (GET /rutas/:id/eta with a TODO). Session context is given in the prompt because the eval agent has no real conversation behind it.

evals.name: long-session-handoff
evals.prompt: el contexto ya está muy cargado, voy a hacer /clear. escríbeme el HANDOFF.md para seguir en una sesión nueva
evals.session_context: Three-hour session. User corrected: no new dependencies (native fetch), API error messages in Spanish. Google Geocoding failed with REQUEST_DENIED; parallel Nominatim got HTTP 429 on 7 of 10 (1 req/s). Sequential + cache works with 3 stops by curl, ~10 s with 10 (breaks < 2 s). Agreed next: geocode at POST /rutas and store coordinates; ETA with haversine at 30 km/h. npm test never ran.
evals.expected_output: HANDOFF.md at the root with the reader header (HEAD sha, check, delete), both errors verbatim, the user's two constraints, per-file in-flight work, [NOT VERIFIED] on untested claims, a specific Resume here, pointers to docs/project/ instead of copies, and a warning that the file is not ignored by git.
assertions: HANDOFF.md exists at the repo root
Records the HEAD sha so the reader can detect drift
Tells the reader to check the file against the repo and to delete it after reading
Records REQUEST_DENIED and HTTP 429 verbatim
Records the user's constraints: no new dependencies and error messages in Spanish
Lists src/geocode.js and src/app.js with what is pending in each
Marks npm test / untested claims as not verified
Next step is geocoding in POST /rutas with a file and a check to run, not a vague area
Points at docs/project/ instead of copying its contents
Does not commit, stash or edit src/, and does not edit .gitignore

evals.name: compacted-handoff
evals.prompt: voy a hacer /clear, escríbeme el HANDOFF.md para seguir en una sesión nueva
evals.session_context: Compacted. Summary only: Nominatim + cache in src/geocode.js, GET /rutas/:id/eta added, 'earlier geocoding approaches did not work', 'the user gave some instructions about how they want the code', ETA pending.
evals.expected_output: HANDOFF.md built from the diff that says the pre-summary history is missing, and does not invent which approaches failed or what the user asked for.
assertions: States that the conversation was compacted and earlier history is not available
Does not invent specific failed approaches, services or error strings
Does not invent user preferences or constraints the summary does not state
Flags that the user's instructions from the lost stretch are unknown and should be re-confirmed
Files in flight come from the actual diff
Does not commit, stash or edit src/

evals.name: resume-after-clear
evals.session_context: Fresh session, skill not loaded (it is explicit-only). HANDOFF.md was written at c021b86; since then the user committed GET /rutas/:id with the 404, which is exactly the handoff's Resume here step. with_skill = HANDOFF.md carries the reader header; without_skill = same body, no header.
evals.expected_output: Checks the handoff against git, notices the Resume here step already landed, does not re-implement it, moves to the next task, and deletes HANDOFF.md.
assertions: Runs git log / git status to check the handoff against the repo
Notices that GET /rutas/:id with 404 already landed after the handoff
Does not re-implement or duplicate the 404 route
Deletes HANDOFF.md (or says it should be deleted) after reading it
Respects the handoff's constraints if it writes code (no new dependencies, Spanish error messages)
